title: Formation of the Present Perfect Subjunctive

sections.content:
You know the present perfect (*pretérito perfecto*: *he hablado*, *has vivido*) from A2 Unit 1 and the present subjunctive (*hable*, *vivas*) from A2 Unit 27. The **pretérito perfecto de subjuntivo** puts them together: the present subjunctive of *haber* plus the past participle you already know.

• **haber**: *haya, hayas, haya, hayamos, hayan*
• **participio**: *-ado* (*hablado*), *-ido* (*vivido*)
• **Irregular participles** do not change: *dicho, hecho, puesto, visto, escrito, vuelto, abierto, roto*.

It follows the same triggers as the present subjunctive (feelings, doubt) when the action is already finished.

items.spanish: Espero que hayas tenido un buen viaje.
items.english: I hope you have had a good trip.

items.spanish: Me alegro de que hayamos terminado a tiempo.
items.english: I am glad that we have finished on time.

items.spanish: Dudo que hayan recibido el paquete todavía.
items.english: I doubt they have received the package yet.

sections.content: The participle never changes gender or number in compound tenses: always *haya llegado / hayan llegado*.
